workflow_instructions.mode_overview: AutoCAD_Specialist mode provides comprehensive workflows for implementing AutoCAD automation, debugging COM integration issues, and creating production-ready CAD solutions. This mode specializes in translating AutoCAD research into working Python code.

step.title: Analyze Requirements
step.description: Understand the AutoCAD integration requirements and current implementation state

actions.action: Review existing AutoCAD interface code and error patterns
Identify specific AutoCAD APIs and methods needed

step.title: Set Up Development Environment
step.description: Ensure proper COM integration and testing setup

actions.action: Configure Mock mode for development testing
Set up proper COM initialization patterns
Establish error handling and logging frameworks

step.title: Plan Implementation Strategy
step.description: Design the approach for AutoCAD integration

actions.action: Plan error handling and recovery mechanisms
Define testing strategy with Real/Mock modes

phase.name: connection_management
phase.description: Establish reliable AutoCAD connection and session management

steps.step: Implement proper COM initialization with pythoncom.CoInitialize()
Create connection manager with retry logic and error handling
Set up AutoCAD application and document references
Configure model space and active layer management
Establish cleanup procedures for COM objects

phase.name: geometry_implementation
phase.description: Implement geometry creation and manipulation methods

steps.step: Convert Python coordinates to AutoCAD VARIANT arrays
Implement basic geometry creation (lines, circles, arcs)
Add complex geometry support (polylines, splines, helixes)
Handle coordinate transformations and unit conversions
Implement geometry validation and error checking

phase.name: entity_manipulation
phase.description: Implement entity creation, modification, and management

steps.step: Create layer management and organization
Implement entity property manipulation
Add dimension and annotation creation
Handle entity selection and grouping
Implement entity cleanup and disposal

phase.name: error_handling
phase.description: Implement comprehensive error handling and debugging

steps.step: Handle COM-specific errors (-2147352567, etc.)
Implement connection failure recovery
Add parameter validation and type checking
Create detailed logging for troubleshooting
Provide fallback mechanisms for failed operations
Minimize API calls through batching
Implement efficient parameter marshalling
Cache frequently used objects and references
Optimize memory usage and cleanup
Monitor and profile performance bottlenecks

test_category.name: unit_testing
test_category.description: Test individual AutoCAD methods and functions

tests.test: Parameter marshalling and VARIANT array conversion

test_category.name: integration_testing
test_category.description: Test AutoCAD integration with spiral stair components

test_category.name: mock_vs_real_testing
test_category.description: Validate consistency between Mock and Real AutoCAD modes

tests.test: Mock mode entity creation matches Real mode
Parameter validation works in both modes

completion_criteria.criterion: AutoCAD connection management is robust and reliable
All geometry creation methods work with proper parameter marshalling
Comprehensive error handling covers all failure scenarios
Code is modular, maintainable, and well-documented
Mock and Real modes produce consistent results
IBC compliance is maintained in all geometric calculations
